review_type: Independent adversarial review of revised question coverage, not summary correctness
verdict_scope: Bounded saturation of meaningful source-backed questions relative to the complete selected 2014 extraction and current 43-question bank.
verdict_rationale: Q43 closes the identified untested noble-shuffling procedure. A fresh complete-source pass, per-candidate recheck of both post-Q43 zero-addition sweeps, and additional counterexample challenges found no uncovered material source procedure or new timing/priority/exception decision. Remaining proposals duplicate covered rules, mechanically combine them, or require a procedure absent from the extraction.

SC01_correction.assessment: Directly tests shuffling before reveal and the mistaken hand-selection alternative; revised R07 correctly replaces the prior development-only Q3 attribution with Q43.
